video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns Hasn’t Slept Since Becoming an NBA Champion; Reflects on the Knicks' Season Win

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the value of the upcoming championship card
quotes.excerpt: I am hunting that Topps Now card of me with the trophy.
quotes.quote: I am hunting that Topps Now card of me with the trophy.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the difficulty of winning a championship in New York
quotes.excerpt: No one can explain winning a championship in New York City.
quotes.quote: No one can explain winning a championship in New York City. And he for the first time is realizing this and all of us in 53 years we haven't seen this.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's ability to unite New York
quotes.excerpt: I have never seen all five boroughs get together.
quotes.quote: It was so amazing to see our team bring together New York. I have never seen all five boroughs get together. Hell, I saw Brooklyn celebrating for the Knicks and they have a whole team.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the healing power of the Knicks' championship run
quotes.excerpt: We were really healing Patrick and them too in this run.
quotes.quote: I don't think for us as the players we can truly understand the magnitude of what we done because it really wasn't meant for us, it was meant for the fans. And I didn't know at that point when you keep thinking about the fans, we were really healing Patrick and them too in this run. And I didn't realize how much healing we would actually do for the city in winning that championship.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Mike Brown's halftime message during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: He came in there at halftime and he was just positive.
quotes.quote: He came in there at halftime and he was just positive. He was more of saying, at least we know now we get to swing for defenses. And for me, being one of the leaders of the team, I just came in at halftime and told them, experience teaches you a lot. We saw ourselves in the same situation last year against Boston in Boston, and we found a way to come back and get the win. So who says we can't do it in front of our own fans?

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the emotional impact of his mother's support
quotes.excerpt: To have my family with me, to see my grandmother, my mom's mom there at the games.
quotes.quote: To have my family with me, to see my grandmother, my mom's mom there at the games and to just see the love she had. It has been a tough couple years for her as a mother, losing your daughter, but for her to kind of see that moment and for me to finally see, when for one of the few times recently, I seen her smile. It just showed how much healing really was being done with this playoff run.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his connection with Jeremy Lin
quotes.excerpt: I feel like people talk to me about Spike, Timothy Chalamet, and Carl Town Senior.
quotes.quote: It is so wild because I was just telling Jordan about this a week or two ago when we are playing the home game and the Knicks posted this video, and Jeremy Lin was coming to Madison Square Garden for the first time in a long time. And they had this journey with him going to the NBA store to buy jerseys, and he mentioned me. And he was like, yeah, I bought me and my kids CAT jerseys, we are big CAT fans. And I was like, man, that is crazy because I am a bigger Jeremy Lin fan. I feel like people talk to me about Spike, Timothy Chalamet, and Carl Town Senior.
